comments.author: Sam C-137
comments.body_html:
Blackout is a feature of ISB SOF, not ISB Aishi, but basically, the chance of a blackout is linked to the chance of bots spawning in Labs. For example:

If you set the bot spawn rate to 50% in Labs and the Blackout Chance to 100% = If ISB bots spawn in Labs (with a 50% chance), there is a 100% guarantee that the Blackout event will occur.

comments.author: Sam C-137
comments.body_html:
I’m really glad you enjoyed the experience. And the Portuguese translation turned out just right, hehe.

This was just the first chapter; the upcoming missions involving Black Division and the Rogues will use this VisitAPI (https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2788/visitapi-framework#description). And I hope to keep improving the existing missions and rewards.

As for the outfits, I still plan to tweak the texture of some hands. The main problem is that, as you saw, the boss outfits kind of “don’t have hands,” lol. Outfits worn by PMCs use three layers: Body, Lower, and Hands, but the boss outfits don’t have Hands :c. Unfortunately, modeling a new one won’t solve it—I just need to create a texture that fits snugly over an existing hand model.

Anyway, it’s a task I’ll keep working on, and thanks for the message and for liking the mod—I hope you’ll try the ISB bots too, hehe.
